page.help: Verification keeps bots and raiders out. New members only see the rest of the server after they get the verified role. They get it by pressing a button on the verification panel (a message Mewvo posts) or by signing in with Discord. Auto-verify gives the role as soon as they join instead. You can use one or the other, not both.

panel.title: Verification panel
panel.channelHelp: Pick a channel new members can see before they are verified.
panel.roleSetupHelp: The role members get once verified. Set your channels so that only this role can see them.
panel.roleHelp: The role members get once verified.
panel.setup: Set up and post the panel
panel.savingNote: Saving does not change the message already in Discord. Press "Update or re-post the panel" to show the new text.

quiz.title: Rules quiz

help.one: Before members get verified, they answer up to {count} question about your rules. They need every answer right; after a wrong try they wait before trying again, and they are not told which answer was wrong. Members who pass go on to the normal verification step. Off by default.
help.other: Before members get verified, they answer up to {count} questions about your rules. They need every answer right; after a wrong try they wait before trying again, and they are not told which answer was wrong. Members who pass go on to the normal verification step. Off by default.

quiz.question: Question
quiz.placeholder: Which of these is a rule here?
quiz.slotsNote: Empty question slots are skipped; clear a slot to remove that question. The answers are shown in a random order each time.
quiz.warnNoQuestions: The quiz is on but has no valid questions, so it is treated as off: members are not asked anything. Add a question below.

warnInvalid.one: {count} stored question is not valid and skipped. Save the questions again to clean this up.
warnInvalid.other: {count} stored questions are not valid and skipped. Save the questions again to clean this up.

quiz.warnPanelOff: The verification panel is off, so nobody gets the quiz until it is on.

suggestFull.one: All {count} question is used. Remove one to get a suggestion.
suggestFull.other: All {count} questions are used. Remove one to get a suggestion.

quiz.suggestNoRules: There are no server rules to suggest from yet. Add them on the Rules page first.

suggested.one: {count} suggested question is filled in below. Nothing is saved yet: check them, edit them, then press Save questions.
suggested.other: {count} suggested questions are filled in below. Nothing is saved yet: check them, edit them, then press Save questions.

auto.title: Auto-verify
auto.criteriaHelp: Members who do not match still have to use the panel.
auto.criteriaAge: Accounts older than the days below
auto.criteriaSmall: Everyone, while the server is still small
auto.ageHelp: Only used when you pick accounts older than the days below. New accounts are more often bots.

web.title: Web verification
web.help: Members can also verify on a web page by signing in with their Discord account.
web.pageHelp: The web page members land on after they verify by signing in with Discord. Leave empty for the default page.

action.setUp: Verification set up: the panel is posted and verification is on.
action.posted: The panel was missing: a new one is posted.
action.updated: The live panel now shows the saved text.
action.toggleNote: Turning it on or off does not post or remove the panel message. Use "Update or re-post the panel" for that.
action.quizOn: The rules quiz is now on.
action.quizOff: The rules quiz is now off.
action.quizEmpty: It has no questions yet, so it is treated as off until you add one.
action.quizNowEmpty: The quiz is on but has no questions now, so it is treated as off.

error.noQuestion: {label}: write the question, or clear its answers to remove it.
error.quizChanged: The quiz questions changed in the meantime. Reload the page and try again.
error.alreadySetUp: The verification panel is already set up. Use "Update or re-post the panel" instead.
error.autoIsOn: Auto-verify is on. Turn auto-verify off before turning the verification panel on.
error.notSetUp: The verification panel is not set up yet. Set it up first.
error.messageEmpty: The panel message cannot be empty.
error.blocked: To turn auto-verify on, first turn off: {list}.
error.atTop: That question is already at the top.
error.atBottom: That question is already at the bottom.
